meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析、比较与注释进化树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理系统发育数据并需要比较树结构。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze, compare, and annotate phylogenetic trees.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with phylogenetic data and need to compare tree topologies.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能读取并操作系统发育树（Newick/NHX），检测复制/分化事件，并输出可视化图。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理 Newick/Nexus 树文件、比较树拓扑差异，或检测复制/分化事件等进化分析时触发。

say.text: 帮我读取 tree.nw，并显示它的叶子数和节点数。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can read and manipulate phylogenetic trees (Newick/NHX), detect duplication/speciation events, and render visualizations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to process Newick/Nexus tree files, compare tree topologies, or detect duplication/speciation events.

Compare tree1.nw and tree2.nw using Robinson-Foulds distance.
Annotate each leaf of this tree with NCBI taxonomy.
